subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram onboarding: offer BotFather web app flow next to the chat flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked Telegram onboarding copy/docs change that presents BotFather's web app as an alternative to the chat-command token flow?
rationale: The change is small and aligned with first-run UX, but it is a maintainer-labelled user-facing onboarding feature with an open implementation PR, so cleanup automation should not decide product acceptance by closing this issue.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the low-risk wizard and docs copy update if PR review confirms wording, locale coverage, and real behavior proof are acceptable.

options.title: Narrow to docs only
options.body: Ask the PR to document the web flow while leaving interactive wizard copy unchanged.

options.title: Keep only the chat flow
options.body: Close the PR and this issue if maintainers do not want to endorse the BotFather web app flow in OpenClaw onboarding.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the low-risk wizard and docs copy update if PR review confirms wording, locale coverage, and real behavior proof are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the listed project maintainer and the current-line history owner for the affected setup/docs copy.
